rules.topic: Crop tiers run 1 to 5 (lines 16-20; the four elemental crops use a tier-1-equivalent 'elemental' tier, line 15), mapping to the essence ladder inferium, prudentium, tertium, imperium, supremium. A crop needs essence farmland of its own tier or higher to grow well; Mystical Agradditions adds tier 6 on top (see its rule file)

Secondary drops: on essence farmland a harvest has the tier's base secondary chance - 10 percent by default (CropTier.java line 47) - of dropping a second seed and essence, plus another 10 percent when the farmland is the crop's effective (matching-tier) farmland, capped at 100 percent total; this is the only built-in seed-multiplication route, so seed supply grows at roughly 10-20 percent per harvest

Hostile mobs drop inferium essence with a 20 percent chance by default config - mob farming is the bootstrap source of essence before inferium crops exist; the wither and ender dragon additionally drop essence and cognizant dust by default (config lines 67-76)

By default seeds are NOT directly craftable (seedCraftingRecipes defaults false): resource seeds are made at the infusion altar by surrounding a seed base with the target resource, and essence tier upgrades run through the infusion crystal, which has 1000 uses by default (line 55; the master infusion crystal is the infinite upgrade path)

Fertilized essence applied to a crop has a 10 percent default chance per growth interaction to drop bonus essence; growth accelerators placed under the farmland speed crops on a 10-tick cooldown cycle (growthAcceleratorCooldown, line 58) and stack by range coverage
